_comment: Template catalog for deck-builder. One entry per template; the skill defaults to the only entry without asking while a single one exists. Entry files (template.html, budgets.json, slots.json, design-notes.md) are synced from the lane by audience-skills/skills/deck-builder/sync-catalog.sh and are gitignored in this tree; a missing entry directory means the sync has not run.

templates.name: Institutional IR
templates.tagline: Bulge-bracket reporting: banded tables, hairline rules, zero ornament.
templates.best_for: Quarterly and annual results, investor updates, board decks; anything read at desk distance under a skeptical line-by-line read.
templates.avoid_for: Pitches and decks that need warmth or momentum; the genre has no agenda, divider, or closing pages and the restraint reads as cold when the room wants energy.
